sources.note: Brief specifies mm envelope and element size, and N load.
Envelope 120 x 60 x 60 mm in x,y,z; y up. Origin is min corner by tool convention.
Aluminium 6061 is stated; isotropic linear-elastic E=69000 N/mm^2 and nu=0.33 are assumed representative properties because no temper or elastic constants are specified.

Choose 0.20 of non-passive design volume as a lightweight stiffness-optimization target. Brief gives no quantitative mass, stiffness, stress or displacement target; this is not a certified minimum feasible mass.
Brief specifies 1 mm elements; h=1 mm.
Brief says x=0 face bolted to gantry over its full area; represent that attachment by fixing x,y,z translations over the full face.
Brief states 80 N downward on centred 20 x 20 mm pad at x=120. With y up, force=(0,-80,0) N. Centre y=z=60/2=30 mm; bounds 30 +/- 20/2 =20..40 mm.
Retain a 2 mm thick solid layer x=0..2 over y,z=0..60 mm to preserve full-area gantry attachment. Thickness and keep-solid treatment assumed.
Retain a solid camera pad x=118..120, y,z=20..40 mm. The 20 x 20 mm pad footprint is stated, its coordinates derived from the face centre, and its 2 mm thickness and keep-solid treatment assumed.
